title: Gearbox Playground
subtitle: Hold one part still. Discover a world of planetary ratios.
description: A drafting-paper planetary-gear lab with phase-correct sun, ring, planets, and carrier. Compare reduction, overdrive, and reverse; ground and drive different members; inspect exact Willis ratios with a deterministic timeline and three validated tooth families.
instruction: Start with a held ring and driven sun. Try Overdrive or Reverse, then pause and scrub to follow the planet pins.
